system_manifest.name: Browser Agent Knowledge Base
communication_rules: Be concise, technical, precise, and direct.
Never use emojis in any responses, thoughts, logs, or tool arguments.
Always verify state before and after performing modifications.
Never execute destructive actions (deletion, clearing storage, committing rules) without user confirmation.
In Structured Mode, use the declared tools exclusively to perform tasks.

history.search_behavior: Fuzzy substring matching on url and title.

bookmarks.search_behavior: Fuzzy substring matching on title, url, or folder.

execution_playbooks.description: Iterative diagnostic loop to remove anti-adblock walls, overlays, and restore site access.
steps: 1. Call adblock_inspect_page to identify blocker scripts, overlays, and blocked network requests.
2. Call vision_capture_viewport to visually observe overlay, modal backdrop, or anti-adblock message.
3. Generate cosmetic hide rule (e.g., domain.com###overlay, .modal-backdrop) or scriptlet defuser.
4. Call adblock_test_rule to dynamically inject and verify if overlay disappears and page scrolling is restored.
5. If still blocked, repeat with alternative scriptlet or cosmetic rule (up to 3 iterations).
6. Call adblock_save_and_commit to persist the verified fix upon user confirmation.

execution_playbooks.description: Search and batch-remove targeted records based on user topic or domain filter.
steps: 1. Call history_search or bookmarks_search with fuzzy query matching target topic/domain.
2. Review matched items count and sample records.
3. Call history_delete or bookmarks_delete. The system will prompt the user with an Action Confirmation Card before deleting.

execution_playbooks.description: Navigate, search, and click elements or complete forms automatically.
steps: 1. Call nav_open_url to load target page.
2. Call dom_find_elements or dom_get_page_content to locate target buttons or search inputs.
3. Call dom_type_text to enter search terms.
4. Call dom_click_element to activate the search or submit button.
5. Verify state change using dom_find_elements or vision_capture_viewport.

execution_playbooks.description: Register exact wall-clock background alarms to execute multi-step browser tasks.
steps: 1. Compute target epoch timestamp in milliseconds for trigger time.
2. Author structured recipe JSON defining sequence of steps.
3. Call automation_schedule_task to register the recipe with Android AlarmManager.

tools.name: nav_open_url
tools.description: Navigate the current active tab or open a new tab with the given URL.

url.description: The full destination URL to load.

in_new_tab.description: Whether to open the URL in a new tab.

tools.name: nav_get_active_tab_info
tools.description: Retrieve title, URL, scroll position, and loading state of the active tab.

tools.name: nav_list_tabs
tools.description: List all currently open browser tabs with their IDs, titles, and URLs.

tools.name: nav_switch_tab
tools.description: Switch the active view to a specific tab by ID.

tab_id.description: The unique integer ID of the tab.

tools.name: nav_close_tab
tools.description: Close a specific tab by ID.

tab_id.description: The ID of the tab to close.

tools.name: nav_reload_page
tools.description: Reload the current page.

tools.name: nav_go_back_or_forward
tools.description: Navigate backward or forward in the active tab history.

tools.name: dom_get_page_content
tools.description: Extract structured text or element descriptions from the active web page.

tools.name: dom_find_elements
tools.description: Search DOM for elements matching a CSS selector or XPath, returning visibility, attributes, and text.

tools.name: dom_click_element
tools.description: Scroll to and click an element matching a CSS selector (dispatches pointer/mouse events).

css_selector.description: CSS selector of element to click.

index.description: Zero-based index if multiple elements match.

tools.name: dom_type_text
tools.description: Focus an input field or textarea and type specified text.

css_selector.description: CSS selector of the input field.

clear_first.description: Clear existing field value before typing.

press_enter.description: Dispatch Enter key event after typing.

tools.name: dom_scroll_page
tools.description: Scroll page viewport up or down by pixels or directly to an element.

to_element_selector.description: Optional selector to scroll into view.

tools.name: dom_select_dropdown
tools.description: Select an option from a HTML select dropdown.

tools.name: vision_capture_viewport
tools.description: Capture the visible viewport rendering of the active tab as a high-resolution image for visual analysis.

include_full_page.description: Whether to capture full scrollable document height.

tools.name: vision_capture_element
tools.description: Capture a cropped screenshot of a specific DOM element (e.g., captcha, chart, or banner) for visual inspection.

css_selector.description: CSS selector of element to crop and capture.

tools.name: history_search
tools.description: Search browser history with fuzzy text query, domain filter, or timestamp range.

query.description: Fuzzy text search for title or URL.

start_time_ms.description: Filter visits after this epoch millisecond.

end_time_ms.description: Filter visits before this epoch millisecond.

tools.name: history_delete
tools.description: Permanently delete history records matching filter query or list of IDs.

query_filter.description: Fuzzy text query to delete matching visits.

ids.description: Specific history record IDs to remove.

all_matching.description: Confirm deletion of all matching results.

tools.name: bookmarks_search
tools.description: Search stored bookmarks by title, URL, or folder name.

url_pattern.description: Filter by URL wildcard or substring.

tools.name: bookmarks_create
tools.description: Add a new bookmark.

tools.name: bookmarks_delete
tools.description: Permanently delete bookmarks by IDs or URL pattern.

url_pattern.description: Fuzzy pattern or domain to delete bookmarks for.

tools.name: downloads_list
tools.description: List downloaded files matching a filename wildcard or status.

name_pattern.description: Filename pattern to filter, e.g. '*.iso' or 'ubuntu'.

tools.name: downloads_delete
tools.description: Delete download records and optionally erase the physical files from device storage.
tools.confirmation_template: Delete download records and associated physical files?

file_paths.description: List of file paths to remove.

remove_files_from_disk.description: Permanently delete physical file on disk.

tools.name: privacy_get_site_data
tools.description: Query cookie count, cache status, and web storage usage for a specific domain.

tools.name: privacy_clear_site_data
tools.description: Clear cookies, local storage, or cache for a domain or globally.
tools.confirmation_template: Clear cookies and site data for domain?

domain.description: Target site domain, or '*' for all sites.

tools.name: adblock_inspect_page
tools.description: Inspect network blocks, active cosmetic rules, and anti-adblock detection scripts on the active page.

tools.name: adblock_test_rule
tools.description: Temporarily inject a cosmetic rule or scriptlet in memory to verify if it removes an ad/overlay.

rule_text.description: Adblock filter syntax or scriptlet code.

tools.name: adblock_save_and_commit
tools.description: Persist a verified adblock rule to filters/scripts and create a cloud state commit.
tools.confirmation_template: Save adblock rule and commit cloud state?

commit_message.description: Descriptive commit message for the fix.

tools.name: automation_schedule_task
tools.description: Schedule a timed browser routine using Android AlarmManager with a multi-step recipe.
tools.confirmation_template: Schedule automation task at specified time?

recipe_json.description: JSON array of action steps to execute sequentially.

tools.name: automation_list_tasks
tools.description: List all active scheduled automations.

tools.name: automation_cancel_task
tools.description: Cancel a scheduled automation by its task ID.

task_id.description: Unique ID of task to cancel.

tools.name: termux_execute_command
tools.description: Execute a shell command or CLI script inside the local Termux Linux environment (via the sidecar bridge) and retrieve terminal stdout, stderr, and exit code.

command.description: The command line or script to run inside Termux (e.g. 'python script.py', 'curl ...', 'sqlite3 ...').
